title: First Desolation
summary: The first of many Desolations begins, where the Voidbringers attack Roshar. The Heralds and the Knights Radiant form the first defenses. The Oathpact is established.
archivistNote: Rosharan records of the early Desolations are fragmentary at best. The exact chronology has been reconstructed from singer songs, spren memories, and the few surviving Dawnchant texts.
